head.title: Private Chef vs Restaurant Dubai: How to Choose
head.meta_description: Private chef vs restaurant Dubai: privacy and a bespoke menu at home vs zero setup and a fixed menu out. Costs, food safety and how to choose.
head.h1: Private Chef vs Restaurant Dubai: Choosing for a Special Occasion — Real Prices and Timings

opening_paragraph: The private chef vs restaurant Dubai choice is about control: a private chef booked through myCHEF, from AED 700 per person, cooks a bespoke menu in your own space. A restaurant asks nothing of you and hands back a fixed menu and a shared room. For a milestone you want to feel personal, the chef usually wins; for a spontaneous Tuesday, the restaurant does its job perfectly.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Private chef vs restaurant Dubai: which wins a special occasion?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Private chef vs restaurant Dubai: which wins a special occasion?
new_paragraphs: For a real special occasion, a private chef usually wins, and the reason is exclusivity. Restaurant vs private chef in Dubai is a question of whose night it is. A restaurant seats you in a public room on someone else's schedule; a private chef builds the whole evening around your table, your pace and your guest list. Dubai gives that chef a lot to compete with. Restaurant Week 2026 alone ran more than 125 venues, over 30 of them in the Michelin Guide, according to Dubai Chronicle . That choice is dazzling, but none of those tables are only yours. For a proposal or a landmark birthday, that one difference tends to settle the decision.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: The real case for a private chef at home
replace_in_block.new_heading: The real case for a private chef at home
new_paragraphs: Hire a private chef at home in Dubai and you buy three things a restaurant cannot sell: a bespoke menu, genuine privacy, and no closing time. The chef cooks a private chef dinner planned around your tastes, your allergies and the mood you are after, then serves it in a room with no other tables in it. Private dining vs a restaurant is the difference between a night shaped to you and a night you fit yourself into. The private chef benefits are practical, too. You host in your own villa or apartment, children and older guests stay comfortable, and the private chef experience keeps going long after a restaurant would have wanted the table back. The chef also washes up before leaving, so the last thing you do on a night like that is not the dishes. This is fine dining at home, minus the drive, the parking and the last call.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: When a restaurant is the smarter call
replace_in_block.new_heading: When a restaurant is the smarter call
new_paragraphs: Sometimes the restaurant is the right answer. If you decide at seven that you want dinner out tonight, no private chef or restaurant debate is needed. You book a table and go. A restaurant wins when you want zero setup, a buzzing atmosphere, a view you cannot recreate at home, or one specific kitchen you have been meaning to try. Dubai's line-up runs deep, from Michelin-listed dining rooms to neighbourhood favourites. You give up control of the menu and you share the space, but you gain spontaneity and someone else does the washing up. For big, loud, see-and-be-seen nights, that trade is often exactly what you want.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Private chef cost vs a restaurant, honestly
replace_in_block.new_heading: Private chef cost vs a restaurant, honestly
new_paragraphs: On paper a private chef reads as pricier per head, but the gap narrows fast. MyCHEF private chefs are priced per person, usually from AED 700 to AED 950, with a multi-course celebration for a small group often landing around AED 2,400 to AED 3,600 in total. Weigh the private chef cost against a restaurant on equal terms. A high-end Dubai restaurant adds service, drinks at a markup and, on busy nights, a minimum spend once the occasion gets going. The private chef value is that the whole fee stays on your table and your group, with no other diners and no rushed turnover. For four to eight guests, the two options frequently land closer than people assume.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Is a private chef worth it in Dubai?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Is a private chef worth it in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: For the right night, yes, a private chef is worth it in Dubai when the occasion matters more than the convenience. Ask what you are paying for. If it is a forgettable weekday meal, a restaurant or a takeaway is fine. If it is an anniversary, a proposal, or a birthday you will talk about for years, the private chef value shows up in the details a restaurant cannot manage: the exact dish you love, your music, your timing, your guests and nobody else's. That is the honest private chef comparison. Worth it is not about the lowest bill. It is about whether the evening is yours.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What is the difference between a chef and a private chef?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What is the difference between a chef and a private chef?
new_paragraphs: A chef, in the ordinary sense of the word, cooks in a commercial kitchen for a room full of strangers: a fixed menu, a brigade around them and covers to turn. A private chef cooks for one household and one table, and the job is wider than the cooking. They take the brief, write the menu for the people who will actually eat it, shop for it, cook it in a domestic kitchen on domestic equipment, serve the courses at your pace and leave the kitchen clean. The craft overlaps almost entirely; the working day does not. Two different things also get called by the same name. A full time private chef in Dubai is employed by a household and cooks daily around a family's routine, diet and travel. A private chef booked for an evening is hired for one occasion and gone by midnight. Most people planning a celebration want the second, and that is what myCHEF arranges: a matched chef for your date, from AED 700 to AED 950 per person.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Is the food safe when a chef cooks in your home?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Is the food safe when a chef cooks in your home?
new_paragraphs: Yes, private cooking for guests in Dubai is a licensed, regulated activity, not a grey area. Cooking for a private party falls under the Party Cook business activity, code 5629.92, which the Meydan Free Zone notes requires Dubai Municipality Food Safety Department approval and registration on the FoodWatch platform before any food is prepared. On top of that, food handlers are expected to hold recognised training, such as the Person in Charge or basic food-hygiene certification, through Dubai Municipality-approved programmes . A serious private chef treats your kitchen with the same hygiene discipline a licensed restaurant kitchen has to follow.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: How myCHEF vets its private chefs
replace_in_block.new_heading: How myCHEF vets its private chefs
new_paragraphs: Every myCHEF chef is checked before they ever cook for you. We run identity checks, a practical cooking assessment and reference verification, then keep watching quality through ongoing reviews after real events. So when Ahmed Al-Rashid plans a fine-dining tasting menu or Marco Rossi builds an Italian and Mediterranean spread, you are booking a chef whose skill has been tested, not just described. That vetting is a quiet part of the private chef vs restaurant Dubai answer. A restaurant kitchen is anonymous; your private chef is a named professional standing in your own home. If a dish or a detail matters, you talk to the person cooking it.

replace_in_block.new_heading: Private chef vs restaurant: an honest comparison
new_paragraphs: Private chef Restaurant

Is a private chef cheaper than a restaurant in Dubai?

Not reliably cheaper per head, but often closer than people expect. MyCHEF private chefs start from AED 700 to AED 950 per person, and once a high-end restaurant adds drinks, service and a minimum spend, the numbers land close for four to eight guests.
Do private chefs also do the dishes?

Yes. Clearing down is part of the booking rather than an extra: the chef clears the table, washes the pans, plates and glassware used for the meal, and leaves the kitchen as they found it. What a private chef is not is a cleaner, so the rest of the house stays your problem, but you will not wake up to the dinner.
How much does a private chef cost in Dubai?

How much you pay comes down to guest count and menu. MyCHEF prices per person, from AED 700 to AED 950, with a multi-course celebration for a small group often landing around AED 2,400 to AED 3,600 in total. There is no minimum headcount on a private chef booking, so a dinner for two is a real product.
What is the difference between a chef and a private chef?

A chef cooks a fixed menu in a commercial kitchen for a room of strangers. A private chef plans, shops, cooks, serves and clears for one table, in your home, on your timing. Same craft, a very different day. A full time private chef goes further again, cooking daily for one household rather than for a single occasion.
Is a private chef worth it for a special occasion?

For a milestone, usually yes. The private chef value is a bespoke menu, real privacy and your own timing, which a shared restaurant room cannot match for a proposal, an anniversary or a landmark birthday.
Is home cooking by a private chef legal and safe in Dubai?

Yes. Cooking for a private party sits under the regulated Party Cook activity, code 5629.92, which needs Dubai Municipality Food Safety approval and FoodWatch registration, and food handlers hold recognised hygiene training.
Can a private chef handle dietary needs a restaurant cannot?
Usually, yes. Because the menu is built for your table alone, a private chef can work around allergies, halal, vegan or medical diets far more precisely than a fixed restaurant menu allows.
How far ahead should I book a private chef in Dubai?
Book as early as you can for weekends and peak season. Share your date, guest count and venue with myCHEF and you will receive an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.

add_block.new_heading: How to decide, in five minutes
new_paragraphs: Name what the night is for. A milestone that has to feel personal points at a chef; a good meal out on a free evening points at a restaurant, and there is no shame in either.
Count the seats. Two to twelve at one table is where a chef at home is at its best. Beyond that you are planning an event, and catering is the honest answer.
Check the diary. Tonight is a restaurant. A private chef experience is usually set about 48 hours ahead, and weekends and peak season go earlier than that.
Compare like with like. Put the restaurant's food, drinks, service charge and any minimum spend beside a per-head chef quote of AED 700 to AED 950 before you call either one expensive.
Ask who cleans up. A chef clears and washes up before leaving; a restaurant hands you the drive home instead.
Say the diets out loud early. Allergies, halal and medical diets are designed into a private menu when you book, not negotiated in the last 48 hours.
